instructions.original_snippets: NEVER trust external data without validating it at the boundary
instructions.content: Never trust external data (an API response, form input) without validating it at the boundary where it enters the typed world; a type annotation on parsed JSON is a claim, not a check.

instructions.original_snippets: Derive the type from the Zod schema with z.infer rather than declaring it separately
instructions.content: Derive a type from its Zod schema with z.infer<typeof Schema> rather than declaring the type separately, so the compile-time type and the runtime check cannot drift apart.

instructions.original_snippets: NEVER model a set of mutually exclusive fields as independent optionals
instructions.content: Never model mutually exclusive fields as independent optional properties on one interface; unify them into a discriminated union so an impossible combination cannot be constructed.

instructions.original_snippets: Design types before writing the implementation
instructions.content: When redesigning a type to remove an illegal state, look for every field pair that only makes sense together and unify each pair into its own discriminated union before combining them.

instructions.original_snippets: NEVER let implementation details leak past a module's intended public surface
instructions.content: Never let a grab-bag module keep growing; split it into single-function modules with a barrel index.ts so each function's file is unambiguous and existing import paths keep working.
